name: dragon-darts
flavor_text: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
effect_text_extend: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.
effect_text_simple: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.
